result:
I’d remove the ability to dehumanize others.

Not by forcing anyone to be kind, but by making it impossible to reduce another person to a category, obstacle, or abstraction without briefly feeling their reality as vividly as your own.

So much harm survives not because people are monsters, but because distance makes other people feel less real. If that distance collapsed, cruelty would lose most of its footing.
